name: Orc

traits.name: Adrenaline Rush
traits.description: You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action. When you do, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all uses when you finish a Short Rest or Long Rest.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.description: When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead. You regain this trait after a Long Rest.

reviewNotes: First-pass baseline is SRD 5.2.1; this is the sole Orc Species candidate in the staged 5e/5.5e SRD.
3.5e Orc light sensitivity is not automatically reinstated because the later baseline omits it. Its potential return remains an independent balance question.
Historical Orc ability-score modifiers and learned languages are not automatic grants in this Species baseline. The appropriate Upbringing remains open for later reconciliation.
Half-Orc remains reserved for Mixed Species rather than being promoted as an Orc Ancestry.
